answer: Like a mycelium meadow weaving soil into one living web, consensus demands interconnected proof-of-interaction. Reputation acts like light entering an onyx crystal: forged in dense singular history, not easily multiplied. When trust disperses across peer endorsements, an identity becomes a prism splitting singular truth into verifiable deeds. Sybil attackers trying to counterfeit trust face superlinear attacker cost via recursive graph-cut validation.
